messages:
nina.devex: FYI hit a parity issue in sampleapp onboarding. SDK is sending the header `Prefer-Cache: false` (string) which trips a legacy auth branch and leads to intermittent 401s during token-refresh. curl/rest UI that omit the header are fine.

tobias.sdk: ah interesting. we have a serializer that does `String(value)` for headers/query. if boolean false -> 'false'.

nina.devex: repro:

```
# curl (works)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/onboard \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"name":"acme"}'
```

SDK (sometimes fails):
```
// node sdk v1.8.3
await client.onboard({ name: 'acme' }, { headers: { 'Prefer-Cache': false } });
```
Server logs show branch: if header present and equals 'false' -> consult session-cache -> if token within refresh window return 401.

emily.platform: Ugh. Combined with SDK retry behavior we saw duplicate creates: SDK treats 401 during refresh as retriable and will resend the POST after refresh, resulting in two onboarding records.

marc.eng: So two things to fix: (A) header normalization (omit falsy booleans), (B) retry policy for auth failures on mutating endpoints.

tobias.sdk: Agreed. Proposed immediate fixes: 1) change serializer to omit headers/query params when value is false/null/undefined; 2) default retry policy: do not auto-retry 401 on POST/PUT/PATCH unless an idempotency-key is present. I'll add unit tests covering header permutations.

emily.platform: From platform side, we can add compatibility shim on onboarding route to treat literal 'false' same as missing for 48h deploy window while customers update. I'll only enable per-tenant while we roll.

nina.devex: Action items:
- tobias.sdk: PR for serializer + retry heuristic (ETA: today EOD)
- marc.eng: sampleapp integration test that simulates token refresh mid-request and asserts single create (ETA: tomorrow)
- emily.platform: compatibility middleware + tenant toggle (ETA: today)

ci-bot: ci-status: lint ok, unit tests failing on header-serializer edgecases.

tobias.sdk: pushing a draft PR now: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk/pulls/518 (draft). tagging @marc.eng for test addition.

emily.platform: will coordinate deploy window and post a note in changelog. recommend sending customer advisory if duplicates observed.

nina.devex: thanks — marking P0 for the next SDK patch. Will follow up if we see more customer reports. :thumbsup:
